name: Anker Zolo 35W PD PPS GaN Charger - Fast & Efficient Charging for iPhone, Samsung, and Pixel
description:
Anker Zolo 35W PD PPS GaN Charger (Model A2696)

Experience fast, safe, and efficient charging with the Anker Zolo 35W GaN Charger. Compact yet powerful, this charger is perfect for home, office, or travel.

Key Features

High-Speed Charging: Up to 35W output for rapid charging of smartphones, tablets, and compatible devices.

PD & PPS Support: Power Delivery (PD) with Programmable Power Supply (PPS) dynamically adjusts voltage and current to optimize charging speed and safety.

GaN Technology: Uses advanced Gallium Nitride technology for a smaller, cooler, and more efficient charger.

Universal Voltage: Input range of 100-240V for global compatibility.

Portable Design: Compact dimensions (32 × 31.5 × 36 mm) and lightweight (50g), easy to carry anywhere.

Color Options: Available in sleek Black or White finishes.
